quote: Whenever a motor vehicle is being operated on the traveled portion of the highway, or shoulder adjacent thereto, during the times specified in NRS 484D.100 [NRS-484D-100-1], the driver shall use a distribution of light, or composite beam, directed high enough and of sufficient intensity to reveal persons and vehicles at a safe distance in advance of the vehicle, subject to the following requirements and limitations: Whenever the driver of a vehicle follows another vehicle within 300 feet to the rear, the driver shall use a distribution of light permissible under this chapter other than the uppermost distribution of light specified in subsection 1 of NRS 484D.210 [DEF-NRS-484D-210-1-2].

activation.condition: Motor vehicle operated on the traveled highway or adjacent shoulder during NRS 484D.100 lighting times and following another vehicle to the rear.

obligation.description: Use a distribution permissible under the chapter other than the uppermost distribution while following within 300 ft; the opening clause also requires illumination to a safe distance.

timing.description: Apply throughout the interval of following within 300 ft while the lighting-time and roadway premises hold.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: safe distance in advance of the vehicle
judgment_calls_needed.note: Safe illumination distance has no numeric value in this assigned subsection.
Native high/low beam bits do not independently establish a permissible distribution.
